fields.fieldText:
KNOWLEDGE BASE ARTICLE UPDATE REQUEST


Updating Knowledge Base articles is one of the keys in improving our organization's learning and efficiency.


You as a user, are empowered to submit changes that you see fit specially in scenarios when updates are utmost needed. A good example of these scenarios are as follows:

  • Finding something wrong in the article
  • The outcome experienced was not the same as described in the Knowledge Base article
  • The steps provided in the Knowledge Base article are incorrect or are no longer applicable

Below are all the articles you've attached to this case. Please select the article you wish to update.

fields.fieldText:
KNOWLEDGE BASE ARTICLE SUBMISSION


Submitting new Knowledge Base articles is one of the keys in improving our organization's learning and efficiency.


You as a user, are empowered to submit new Knowledge Base articles specially in scenarios when no available articles or other references are available. A good example of these scenarios are as follows:


  • There are no available RC 411s, Knowledge Base articles, or troubleshooting guides that discusses your issue
  • A new product or feature has just been released and the reference materials that are available at your disposal does not fully discuss the problems being encountered
  • You have a better solution different from what was described by an article
